Name: Highlighted Jars
Author: Annosz
Description:
[size=5]Highlighted Jars
[/size]
This mod highlight jars, kegs and casks which are not currently used with either a red color or with a speec-bubble with an exlamation mark. This can help farmers to identify unused containers faster and help them with optimizing their production.



[size=4]Requirements[/size]

This mod requires SMAPI.



[size=4]Compatibility[/size]

This mod has no known compatibility issues, but the highlight option can work poorly with other mods that change the containers color, eg. [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/687]Darker Wood and Gold Craftables[/url]﻿, as sometimes the red recolor is barely visible with these.



[size=4]Configuration[/size]

In the config.json you can change:
[list]
[*]The type of the highlight: set either [b]Highlight [/b]or [b]Bubble [/b]as a value for this
[*]Which containers are enabled for highlighting.
[/list]


﻿[size=4]Install[/size]
[list=1]
[*][url=https://smapi.io/]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].
[*]Download this mod and unzip it into Stardew Valley/Mods.
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list][list=1][code][/code][/list]
